title: VerifiedDR
description: Website authority and AI visibility tools for DR, TrueDR, keywords, backlinks, and partnerships.
summary: Website authority and AI visibility tools for DR, TrueDR, keywords, backlinks, and partnerships.
offersHint: Website authority and AI visibility tools for DR, TrueDR, keywords, backlinks, and partnerships. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://verifieddr.com/api/mcp · Requires headers: Authorization

variables.name: api_key
variables.description: VerifiedDR API key beginning with vdr_

variables.name: api_key
variables.description: VerifiedDR API key beginning with vdr_

toolsPreview.name: account_usage
toolsPreview.description: Your plan, the account-wide AI prompt budget, remaining API quota, and plan entitlements. Call this first: it is how you budget before acting instead of discovering caps as a 402.

toolsPreview.name: list_categories
toolsPreview.description: The category values accepted when submitting a site or filtering discovery (32 values, max 3 per site).

toolsPreview.name: list_sites
toolsPreview.description: All websites on your account with current metrics: DR, TrueDR, weekly/monthly changes, traffic, referring domains, verification state.

toolsPreview.name: submit_site
toolsPreview.description: List a new website on VerifiedDR, owned by your account. Use the primary domain (example.com, not blog.example.com). Owned submits count against the free-tier unverified-site cap.

toolsPreview.name: get_site
toolsPreview.description: One site with DR and traffic history plus latest backlink totals. Resolves your own sites first, then falls back to any approved public site (`owned` says which).

toolsPreview.name: get_truedr
toolsPreview.description: TrueDR (DR weighted by trust and real traffic) for one of YOUR sites, from the stored score. With detailed=true also returns the per-signal trust breakdown and recommended actions — the only place that breakdown is exposed.

toolsPreview.name: export_site
toolsPreview.description: Machine-readable export for one of your sites: current metrics, the full public authority payload, and badge snippets in one response.

toolsPreview.name: lookup_site
toolsPreview.description: Public authority lookup for ANY approved site: DR, TrueDR, trust score, confidence, traffic validation, and latest backlink evidence. Never returns owner data.

toolsPreview.name: get_domain_rating
toolsPreview.description: Domain Rating for ANY domain: the site does not have to be on VerifiedDR. Use it to score a prospect, competitor, or link target before anyone submits it. DR only: TrueDR, trust and traffic need a tracked site, so call `lookup_site` when `listed` is true.

toolsPreview.name: check_site
toolsPreview.description: Stored fraud check for a submitted site: homepage shell detection, domain age, organic-keyword footprint versus backlink profile, and spam score, combined into a real/suspicious/shell/unreachable verdict with plain-language reasons. Read-only and listed-sites-only: reports are created by `submit_site` with `siteCheck: true`, and this returns 404 for unsubmitted domains or until a report exists. Use it to vet link targets, exchange candidates, and outreach prospects before trading anything.

toolsPreview.name: get_trust_map
toolsPreview.description: The public Trust Map (backlink map) for any approved site, from cache: per-domain DR, link type, importance, spam score. Answers 503 if no cached map exists yet.

toolsPreview.name: get_badge_snippets
toolsPreview.description: Ready-to-paste badge and embed snippets (HTML, markdown, share text) plus public links (badge, OG image, sparkline) for any approved site.

toolsPreview.name: monitor_sites
toolsPreview.description: Authority watch across your sites: weekly (or daily) change digest with traffic validation and spam/trust alerts. Optionally restrict to one site.

toolsPreview.name: verify_site
toolsPreview.description: Fetch one of your sites and check the VerifiedDR badge is embedded. Side effect: marks the site verified or unverified based on the result.

toolsPreview.name: find_sites
toolsPreview.description: Discover approved sites by authority for broad website, sponsor, or integration prospecting, ranked by TrueDR then DR. Verified-only by default.

toolsPreview.name: find_link_exchanges
toolsPreview.description: Verified websites open to a relevant editorial link exchange with one of your sites, excluding matches you already contacted or dismissed. Use propose_link_exchange to preview the one-link-each proposal.

toolsPreview.name: propose_link_exchange
toolsPreview.description: Preview or send a one-link-each editorial exchange proposal as the account owner. SENDS REAL EMAIL when dryRun is false. Always preview first and get the user's approval before sending. A dry run can generate the standard proposal when subject and message are omitted.

toolsPreview.name: keyword_difficulty
toolsPreview.description: The DR profile of the live Google top 10 for a keyword: median DR needed, the weakest ranking domain (entry point), and — with your domain — your gap and a verdict. Paid plans only (402 otherwise).

toolsPreview.name: keyword_suggestions
toolsPreview.description: Winnable keywords a domain already ranks 4-30 for, ordered by traffic value, brand queries filtered out. Works for any domain (competitor research). Paid plans only.

toolsPreview.name: list_tracked_keywords
toolsPreview.description: Tracked keyword targets for one of your sites with stored difficulty snapshots (median DR, gap, tier, volume, positions) and 28-day GSC impressions when connected. Free on every plan.

toolsPreview.name: add_tracked_keyword
toolsPreview.description: Add a keyword target to one of your sites and snapshot its difficulty. Per-site keyword cap applies.

toolsPreview.name: refresh_tracked_keyword
toolsPreview.description: Re-snapshot a saved keyword target's difficulty.

toolsPreview.name: remove_tracked_keyword
toolsPreview.description: Remove a tracked keyword target.

toolsPreview.name: get_ai_visibility
toolsPreview.description: How often ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google AI Mode name one of your sites for its tracked questions: score, per-question answers, rival brands, cited pages worth outreach, and run history. Reading never spends budget.

toolsPreview.name: diff_ai_visibility_runs
toolsPreview.description: Compare two stored AI visibility runs: score delta, gained/lost mentions, new/dropped sources behind answers that named the tracked site, and brands that entered or left. Run timestamps come from get_ai_visibility history.

toolsPreview.name: run_ai_visibility_scan
toolsPreview.description: Ask the tracked questions across AI engines NOW. Paid plans only, one run per site per week (inside the cooldown you quietly get the stored run back). This spends real vendor budget — check account_usage first.

toolsPreview.name: add_ai_visibility_prompt
toolsPreview.description: Add one question to a site's AI visibility tracking (8-300 chars; naming your own brand/domain is allowed and tests direct recall). Counts against the account-wide prompt budget. Non-global locations need a paid plan.

toolsPreview.name: import_ai_visibility_prompts
toolsPreview.description: Import several questions at once (bad lines are skipped, so a pasted numbered list works). Counts against the account-wide prompt budget.

toolsPreview.name: set_ai_visibility_prompt_location
toolsPreview.description: Pin one tracked question to a country market. Paid plans only.

toolsPreview.name: reorder_ai_visibility_prompts
toolsPreview.description: Reorder the tracked questions; pass every prompt id in the new order.

toolsPreview.name: reset_ai_visibility_prompts
toolsPreview.description: Throw away the current question set and reseed from the site's keywords. Paid plans only. Destructive: the old questions are gone.

toolsPreview.name: remove_ai_visibility_prompt
toolsPreview.description: Delete one tracked question by its prompt id.

toolsPreview.name: get_growth_plan
toolsPreview.description: The generated growth task plan for one of your sites: ranked tasks with impact, status, and execution artifacts, plus benchmark sites. Free plans get the summary and one revealed action.

toolsPreview.name: run_growth_plan
toolsPreview.description: Generate a fresh growth plan. Paid plans only. Progress on unchanged tasks carries over, so a re-run never reopens finished work.

toolsPreview.name: update_growth_task
toolsPreview.description: Move one growth task's status after executing it.

toolsPreview.name: get_gsc_audit
toolsPreview.description: The latest stored Google Search Console index audit for one of your sites (needs a connected GSC property).

toolsPreview.name: run_gsc_audit
toolsPreview.description: Run a fresh index audit. Spends real GSC URL Inspection quota; 12h cooldown between runs.

toolsPreview.name: get_gsc_performance
toolsPreview.description: Search Console performance for one of your sites: totals vs the preceding period, daily data, and top query/page/country/device snapshots from the existing sync.

toolsPreview.name: marketplace_packages
toolsPreview.description: Backlink Packages on offer, priced for this account (plan discount applied), with the exact websites each package places on.

toolsPreview.name: marketplace_sites
toolsPreview.description: Single-website listings — buy one placement on one website — ranked with your niches first. Each row's websiteId is what marketplace_cart_add_site takes.

toolsPreview.name: marketplace_cart
toolsPreview.description: Your current open marketplace cart.

toolsPreview.name: marketplace_cart_add_package
toolsPreview.description: Add a Backlink Package to the cart. Prices are re-derived server-side; the cart caps at 5 rows.

toolsPreview.name: marketplace_cart_add_site
toolsPreview.description: Add a single-website placement to the cart.

toolsPreview.name: marketplace_cart_set_homepage
toolsPreview.description: Turn the homepage link on or off for one single-placement row. Listings are priced on an article; a homepage link costs 60% more and is only sold where the publisher accepts one (marketplace_cart shows homepageAvailable and homepageUpliftAmount per row).

toolsPreview.name: marketplace_cart_remove
toolsPreview.description: Remove one row from the cart by its index.

toolsPreview.name: marketplace_cart_checkout
toolsPreview.description: Start checkout: returns a Stripe Checkout URL and charges NOTHING. A human opens the URL and enters the card — that boundary is deliberate. Give the URL to the user.

toolsPreview.name: marketplace_orders
toolsPreview.description: Every marketplace order with its placements, their status, and live URLs as publishers deliver. An unbriefed paid order is the thing to chase.

toolsPreview.name: marketplace_order_brief
toolsPreview.description: Brief a paid order so publishers can start (the brief is collected after payment on purpose).

toolsPreview.name: marketplace_requests
toolsPreview.description: What one of your websites is asking other websites for (the Ask side of the marketplace).

toolsPreview.name: marketplace_request_post
toolsPreview.description: Post what your website wants from others and what you'll pay (or pass id to edit an existing ask). Requires a verified website.

toolsPreview.name: marketplace_request_remove
toolsPreview.description: Take a posted ask down.

toolsPreview.name: earn_sites
toolsPreview.description: Every owned website with what it earns per placement, whether it's in the publisher network, and its terms.

toolsPreview.name: earn_join_network
toolsPreview.description: Join the publisher network with one verified website. REFUSES to run without acceptTerms=true, because joining accepts the publisher terms on the owner's behalf — confirm with the user first. Lands in pending for human approval.

toolsPreview.name: earn_update_settings
toolsPreview.description: Tune a network website's placement settings: link types, turnaround, monthly cap.

toolsPreview.name: earn_set_status
toolsPreview.description: Set a network website's status: active, paused (stops new work without leaving), or removed (leaves the network).

toolsPreview.name: earn_assignments
toolsPreview.description: Placements assigned to your websites — target URL, anchor, the buyer's brief, payout, deadline.

toolsPreview.name: earn_accept_assignment
toolsPreview.description: Accept an assigned placement.

toolsPreview.name: earn_decline_assignment
toolsPreview.description: Decline an assigned placement (declining is free and expected).

toolsPreview.name: earn_submit_live_url
toolsPreview.description: Report a placement live — the server fetches the URL and checks the link is actually present before marking it verified. This is what gets you paid.

toolsPreview.name: earn_earnings
toolsPreview.description: What your websites have earned as publishers (USD cents): pending, due, paid, and the payout threshold.

toolsPreview.name: inbox_list
toolsPreview.description: Link exchange conversations and marketplace threads with the unread count. Time-sensitive human work: summarize and draft, don't answer on your own.

toolsPreview.name: inbox_thread
toolsPreview.description: One exchange or marketplace conversation with its messages and relevant context.

toolsPreview.name: inbox_reply
toolsPreview.description: Reply in an exchange or marketplace thread. SENDS REAL EMAIL to the other side as the account owner. Draft and send only on the user's word.

toolsPreview.name: inbox_mark_read
toolsPreview.description: Mark an exchange or marketplace thread as read.
